fields.value: Netzee, Inc. (maintenance provider) and The Bankers Bank, a Georgia banking corporation (paying customer/maintenance recipient).

quotes.text:
NETZEE, INC. THE BANKERS BANK, a Georgia
banking corporation

This Agreement provides for Continued Service and for Netzee to provide basic
maintenance in support following expiration of the initial one (1) year term of
the License/Services Schedule.

Bankers Bank agrees to pay fees equal to $40 per month for all Participating
Banks (original or added) for which maintenance is provided.

quotes.text: COMMENCEMENT DATE FOR MAINTENANCE UNDER THIS ADDENDUM: MARCH 1, 2001

fields.value: Bankers Bank may renew, at its option, for subsequent 1-year periods; not automatic.

quotes.text:
Following the
completion of such maintenance term, Bankers Bank may, at its option, renew
maintenance for subsequent periods of one (1) year each, subject to adjustments
proposed by Netzee not to exceed 5% at least sixty (60) days in advance of
the applicable renewal date.

fields.value: Subject to limitations of liability in the incorporated Master Agreement; cap amount not stated in this document.

quotes.text:
THIS MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT IS GOVERNED BY, AND SHALL BE SUBJECT TO, THE TERMS
AND CONDITIONS OF THE MASTER AGREEMENT BETWEEN NETZEE AND BANKERS BANK,
INCLUDING THE LIMITED WARRANTY AND DISCLAIMER AND LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY
PROVIDED THEREIN. SUCH TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE HEREBY AFFIRMED BY BOTH PARTIES
AND INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE IN THIS MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT, INCLUDING, WITHOUT
LIMITATION, ALL LICENSES GRANTED OR EXERCISABLE THEREUNDER.

ambiguities: The incorporated Master Agreement is not included in the supplied text, so the liability ceiling and any carve-outs cannot be determined from the Master Agreement incorporation paragraph.

payments.description: Monthly maintenance fee stated as $40 per month for Participating Banks for which maintenance is provided, subject to possible renewal-period adjustments proposed by Netzee up to 5%.
payments.conditionNote: The agreement does not state a payment due day within each month; the applicable amount may also depend on the Participating Banks for which maintenance is provided and, for renewal terms, any Netzee adjustment up to 5%.
